title: Sausage and White Bean Skillet
description: Italian sausage browned and braised with cannellini beans, tomatoes, and kale in a single skillet. Rustic, hearty, and the kind of dinner that begs for a hunk of bread on the side.

ingredients.name: Italian sausage links
ingredients.notes: sweet or hot, about 1 lb total

ingredients.name: lacinato kale
ingredients.notes: about 4 cups, stems removed, leaves torn

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat. Add sausage links and brown on all sides, turning occasionally, until the casings are deeply golden, about 6 minutes. They don't need to be cooked through — they'll finish in the sauce. Transfer to a cutting board.
Reduce heat to medium. Add garlic, smoked paprika, and red pepper flakes to the rendered fat in the skillet. Stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add diced tomatoes, chicken broth, and beans. Stir to combine, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Slice the sausages into 1-inch rounds and return them to the skillet, nestling them into the beans. Bring to a simmer.
Pile the kale on top. Cover the skillet and cook until the kale wilts and the sausage registers 160°F internally, about 5 minutes. Uncover and stir the kale into the beans.
Simmer uncovered for another 3 to 4 minutes until the liquid reduces to a saucy consistency — not soupy, not dry. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve in shallow bowls with grated Parmesan and crusty bread.
